architecture.decision: Snapshot process records identify provider/cwd but not a verified conversation. Generate plain Bash tabs and rebuild launch arguments from quoted display fields rather than trusting stored resume commands, scripts or terminal arguments. Native interactive preview quotes cwd/banner and executes only a plain shell. Exact-ID supervised recovery remains separate.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of implementation; no stored-data migration.

validation.evidence: Generated and stale/direct launch plans do not invoke fake Codex/Agy/Claude or injected commands; paths and banner text survive shell metacharacters.
Existing snapshot preview, native virtual desktop and REST/MCP consumers remain compatible.
Full source suite and mandatory four-window X11 pass via Willman; governed scope and hosts pass.
